description: Packages that must move together, who moves them, and the packages held at their current version. `tim deps dependabot <repo>` generates each repo's Dependabot config from this file. The shape is described in tim/README.md under `tim deps dependabot`.

sets.name: eslint
sets.reason: neostandard and the plugins declare eslint as a peer, so bumping eslint alone leaves an install that npm refuses or a config that no longer loads.

sets.name: vitest
sets.reason: @vitest/coverage-v8 and the other @vitest packages pin the exact vitest version they were released with.

sets.name: playwright
sets.reason: The frontends record traces that the tests repo and tim read, and a trace from one Playwright version will not open in another, so every repo moves to the same version on one branch name.

sets.name: govuk-frontend
sets.reason: Its minors ship new components, deprecations and visual changes that green CI cannot prove were applied, so every version goes through the govuk-upgrade skill, one version at a time, across every frontend.

sets.name: node
sets.reason: The Node version is pinned in four places in every repo, none of which Dependabot's npm updates touch, and CI, Docker images and local installs must all run the same version.

holds.reason: stylelint-config-gds 3.0.0, the newest release, has a peer of stylelint ^17.4.0, so stylelint 18 fails npm ci with ERESOLVE
typescript-eslint, newest 8.73.0, has a peer of typescript <6.1.0 because TypeScript 7.0 ships no programmatic API, so typescript 7 fails npm ci with ERESOLVE
